title: Learning to prove: logic, sets, functions and induction
outcome: State quantified claims; distinguish examples from proof; use direct proof, contradiction, induction, and well-ordering.

title: Divisibility, Euclid and Bezout
outcome: Run Euclid and extended Euclid; prove Bézout; solve a linear Diophantine equation and interpret all solutions.

title: Primes, unique factorization and valuations
outcome: Prove Euclid’s lemma and unique factorization without circularity; use valuations to compare divisibility.

title: Congruence, equivalence relations and residue classes
outcome: Build an equivalence relation and define operations on residue classes independently of representatives.

title: Linear congruences and the Chinese remainder theorem
outcome: Solve linear congruences; prove coprime CRT and the general compatibility criterion.

title: Groups, symmetry and subgroups
outcome: Read group axioms through arithmetic and symmetry; distinguish an operation from its underlying set.

title: Cyclic groups, cosets and Lagrange
outcome: Use cyclic subgroups and cosets; prove Lagrange and identify its one-way implications.

title: Homomorphisms, normal subgroups and quotients
outcome: Construct a homomorphism, kernel, normal subgroup and quotient; prove the first isomorphism theorem.

title: Units, orders, Fermat, Euler and RSA
outcome: Use modular orders and Euler/Fermat correctly; derive toy RSA and separate correctness from security.

title: Permutations, parity and alternating groups
outcome: Compose permutations right to left, calculate cycle type and parity, and recognize alternating groups.

title: Group actions, orbit-stabilizer and counting
outcome: Compute orbits and stabilizers; derive Burnside’s lemma and the class equation.

title: Cauchy, Sylow and finite group structure
outcome: Prove Cauchy/Sylow and use divisibility/congruence restrictions to constrain a finite group.
extension: Classification examples beyond the Sylow spine

title: Rings, integral domains and fields
outcome: Distinguish rings, domains, fields, units and zero divisors; explain characteristic.

title: Ideals, quotient rings and ring CRT
outcome: Construct ideals and quotient rings; connect prime/maximal ideals to domains/fields and generalize CRT.

title: Polynomial arithmetic, roots and irreducibility
outcome: Divide polynomials over a field, prove root bounds, apply irreducibility tests and build a simple quotient field.

title: Euclidean domains, PIDs, UFDs and Gaussian integers
outcome: Explain Euclidean ⇒ PID ⇒ UFD and the failure of converses; factor in Gaussian integers.

title: Quadratic residues and the Legendre symbol
outcome: Compute quadratic residues and Legendre symbols; derive Euler’s criterion and the supplementary laws.

title: Gauss lemma and quadratic reciprocity
outcome: Follow Gauss’s lemma and a full quadratic reciprocity proof; decide square solvability efficiently.

title: Arithmetic functions, convolution and Mobius inversion
outcome: Derive divisor-sum identities, Dirichlet convolution, multiplicativity, and Möbius inversion.

title: Diophantine equations, continued fractions and Pell
outcome: Parametrize primitive Pythagorean triples; use continued fractions and Pell equations with justified existence.

title: Finite abelian groups, modules and Smith normal form
outcome: Classify finite abelian groups; interpret generators/relations and a small Smith normal form.

title: Vector spaces, field extensions and constructibility
outcome: Build bases and extension degrees; prove the tower law and use degree obstructions in construction problems.

title: Number fields, algebraic integers and failed factorization
outcome: Work in a number field; distinguish algebraic numbers from algebraic integers and diagnose failed factorization.

title: Finite fields, Frobenius and polynomial factorization
outcome: Construct finite fields, explain their existence/uniqueness and cyclic units, and calculate Frobenius.

title: Field automorphisms and the Galois correspondence
outcome: Use normality, separability, fixed fields and the finite Galois correspondence with precise proof status.
extension: Full general correspondence proof and extension lemmas

title: Cyclotomic polynomials, roots of unity and regular polygons
outcome: Derive cyclotomic polynomials and their irreducibility; connect roots of unity, modular units, and polygons.

title: Computing Galois groups and solvability by radicals
outcome: Compute representative cubic/quartic/quintic groups; explain solvable groups and radical-solvability boundaries.
extension: General radical-solvability theorem and quintic computations

title: Analysis as needed: sums, limits, Euler products and primes
outcome: Rebuild limits, comparison, harmonic divergence and convergent Euler products; distinguish PNT evidence from proof.
extension: Euler-product analysis beyond finite examples; PNT is stated, not proved

title: Hensel lifting and a first look at p-adic integers
outcome: Prove simple-root Hensel lifting; interpret compatible residues and the elementary p-adic viewpoint.

title: Synthesis: finite-field coding and mathematical investigations
outcome: Explain polynomial evaluation codes and erasure recovery; carry out investigations linking arithmetic and algebra.
